title: Morena Holds 217 Assemblies Nationwide in 'Sovereignty' Mobilization
detail: Morena held 217 informational assemblies across all 32 states over the weekend of July 4–5, framed as defending national sovereignty against 'foreign interference and disinformation.' The mobilization is the first major wave of a party-wide campaign — announced in June following a call from President Claudia Sheinbaum — that plans 2,600 assemblies between June and August, with a longer-term goal of 30 million house-to-house visits by year end. Party leaders, including national secretary Ariadna Montiel Reyes, said the assemblies would reaffirm Sheinbaum's 'Cuarta Transformación' achievements and extend to the municipal level, with urban areas organized by electoral district. The push comes as Morena continues to consolidate its territorial dominance and organizational infrastructure ahead of the 2027 midterm elections.

media.caption: Morena launches 217 nationwide assemblies over the July 4–5 weekend
